messages:
Maya: Quick random q — if your mug could talk, what would it say? Asking because my travel mug keeps judging me :sweat_smile:
Sam: 'Fill me. Now.' and then passive-aggressively clinks on the table :coffee: :laughing:
Priya: It would probably be all supportive on Monday: 'You got this. Refill. Also maybe stop microwaving me.' :eyes:
Marcus: Mine would scold me for cold coffee: 'I am warm, not a science experiment.' `#never-let-it-cool`
Diego: 'I hold your secrets. Do not betray me with tea.' (low-key spooky) :ghost:
Ava: It would ask for a raise. 'I'm doing all the heavy lifting here, HR?' :money_with_wings:
Sam: Also mine would judge my mug choices: 'Why did you bring a novelty llama? We have standards.'
Maya: @Priya I microwaved mine once and it crackled like an old vinyl record, so now it whispers passive insults at 7am :grimacing:
coffee-bot: Your mug's caffeine rating is 2/5. Suggest immediate refill. :robot_face:
Priya: Bonus round — what single phrase would your mug say every day? Mine: 'Finish your breakfast, you are better than granola.'
Marcus: 'Stop reheating. It won't turn into new coffee.' *also probably my mug's last words*
Diego: 'Please, no oat milk today.' (personal vendetta) :sweat_smile:
Maya: Love these. New team ritual idea: mugs tell one truth at standup. Who's in? :raised_hands:
